structuredContent.latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the critic stage under the single native Goal. The activation binding guard passed before I read case material. The Goal completed with status `complete`; the guard cannot independently prove receipt provenance or freshness, so those remain **UNKNOWN** beyond its check.

The critique finds the draft broadly faithful to the brief, with no material wrong correction identified. It flags two material gaps: CouchDB’s `conflicts=true` response provides losing revision IDs, while retrieving their bodies requires `open_revs`; and the assigned inputs did not identify the existing application repository, callers, or tests. [CouchDB conflict documentation](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/replication/conflicts.html) It also corrects the carried status for Automerge issue #889 and notes that the fix is listed in CouchDB’s upstream 3.5.3 release notes, while the deployed package remains unknown. [Issue #889](https://github.com/automerge/automerge/issues/889) · [CouchDB 3.5 release notes](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/whatsnew/3.5.html)

No application tests, crash tests, benchmarks, or prototypes were run. The released discovery and plan hashes match `plan-reveal.json`.
